theme: An open Sunday in St. Pete.
greeting: Just one short review with Mike on the calendar today, then an open Sunday with the girls in St. Pete. The quiet leaves room for the two things that have been waiting: a reply to the NACD-NE committee and the Maine Christmas rental.

needsAttention.title: Reply to Kevin on the NACD-NE committee
needsAttention.detail: Kevin McGovern forwarded his note about joining NACD New England's Maine Programming Committee — it bounced off your old KPMG address. A reply from this account gets you looped in with the chapter group.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out early. Booking refundable now removes the risk — this p1 has been sitting since Sept 14.
